dialog.title: Share settlement report
dialog.description: Create a public, read-only link so anyone can view this event's balances without signing in. The link expires automatically after 1 day.

premium.gateBody: Sharing a settlement report link is a Premium feature. Premium is granted manually by an administrator — contact the operator to unlock it.

create.destinationHint: The transfer QR on the public page will point to this account.
create.noBankHint: You can still create a link (without a QR). Add a bank account in Wallet to enable the transfer QR on the public page.

link.expiredBody: This share link has expired. Regenerate it to get a new link.
link.noQrHint: This link has no QR (no receiving account was chosen at creation).
link.confirmRevoke: Revoke the link? Anyone holding the old link will no longer be able to view it.
link.confirmRegenerate: Regenerate the link? The old link stops working immediately.

notClosed.title: Event not closed
notClosed.body: A settlement report can only be shared after the event is closed. Close the event and try again.

error.title: Could not load the link
error.qrBody: Something went wrong loading the QR. Please try again.

qr.emptyBody: No members currently owe anything, so there is no QR to show.

public.caption: Per-member debt balances for the event
public.emptyBody: This event has no expenses to settle yet.

breakdown.title: {{name}}'s shares
breakdown.empty: This member has no shares in the event.

expired.title: Link unavailable
expired.body: This link has expired, was revoked, or does not exist. Contact whoever shared it for a new link.

stream.revokedBody: The event owner revoked or regenerated this link. The report you were viewing is no longer updating — ask the owner for a new link.
stream.expiredBody: This link's time limit has passed. The report you were viewing is no longer updating — ask the owner for a new link.
stream.qrMemberSettledBody: This member no longer owes anything, so their QR was closed.
